question: Amit invests a sum of ₹5400 and Gopal invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 3 years, Gopal gets ₹840 more interest than Amit, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The extra interest Gopal gets is solely due to his extra principal.

Difference in Principal = 9400 − 5400 = 4000

Difference in SI = (Difference in P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 840 = (4000 × R × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 120R = 840 ⇒ R = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7%.**
